skill.title: Skill
skill.guide.title: You don't have any Skills yet. Let's create one!
skill.guide.desc: Manage all your Skills in one place. Create or import a Skill in one click from a natural-language description, and reuse it to give agents professional execution capabilities for specific scenarios.
skill.guide.step1.title: Create a Skill
skill.guide.step1.des: Click Create Skill or Import. If you choose Create Skill, enter a natural-language description, and the system automatically generates the specification document, aligns its understanding with you, and writes the code end to end.
skill.guide.step2.title: Debug and Enable
skill.guide.step2.des: Debug the Skill's responses online and enable it.
skill.create.placeholder: Describe the Skill you want to create. For example: "Create a business travel Skill that helps users plan trips, search for flights, and more."
skill.import_zip_tip:
1. Only ZIP files are supported. The file size must be ≤ 10 MiB.
2. After decompression, the package must contain exactly one folder. The folder name must match the Skill name in SKILL.md, and SKILL.md must be in the root directory of the folder.
skill.import_zip_error_tip: Failed to import file {{name}} due to a local network error. Try importing again, or check whether your local network and configuration are working properly.
skill.import_obs_error_tip: Failed to import the OBS resource due to a local network error. Try importing again, or check whether your local network and configuration are working properly.
skill.import_obs_tip: Upload the Skill ZIP file to Object Storage Service (OBS), obtain the file URL, and enter it here. The file size must be ≤ 10 MiB.
skill.import.obs.label: OBS URL
skill.import.obs.input.placeholder: Enter the OBS file URL, for example: https://{bucket-name}.{OBS-domain}/{file-path}
skill.import.obs.input.valid.address: Enter a URL in the correct format.
